name: Plvgin Brand Showcase for Elementor
author: plvgin

sections.description:
Plvgin Brand Showcase adds a professional Brand Showcase widget to your Elementor panel. It automatically reads your WooCommerce brand taxonomy and renders every brand as a premium, hover-animated card — complete with logos, names, product counts, and a live search bar.

Key Features

  • Auto-detects the brand taxonomy from popular plugins (Perfect WooCommerce Brands, YITH WooCommerce Brands, or any custom taxonomy)
  • Zero manual entry — brands are fetched live from your database
  • Monogram placeholder when a brand has no logo set
  • Live search bar — filter brands client-side with no page reload
  • Product count badge on each card
  • Flexible card styles: Logo Only / Logo + Name / Logo + Name + Count
  • Order by Name, Product Count, or Random
  • Responsive grid — configurable per breakpoint
  • Premium hover effects: lift, glow, shimmer line, logo scale
  • Full Elementor style controls: colours, typography, border, shadow, padding

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • Elementor 3.5.0+ (free)
  • A brand taxonomy (e.g. Perfect WooCommerce Brands or YITH Brands)
  • PHP 7.4+
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plvgin-brand-showcase folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure Elementor and a brand taxonomy plugin are active.
  4. Edit any page with Elementor and search for “Brand Showcase” under the Plvgin Brand Showcase category.
sections.faq:
Which brand plugins are supported?

Perfect WooCommerce Brands (pwb-brand), YITH WooCommerce Brands (yith_product_brand), and any custom taxonomy by entering its slug manually.

What if a brand has no logo?

A monogram placeholder (first two letters) is shown automatically.

Does the widget link to brand archive pages?

Yes — enable “Link Cards to Brand Archive” in the widget settings.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The query uses get_terms() (cached by WordPress), and the search filter is pure vanilla JS with no jQuery dependency.
